Natural selection is the main mechanism of evolution.

definition: easy to see or understand
examples: The benefits of vaccination are obvious from historical data.
The two species are obviously related.

definition: to fill or use a space or time; to take control of a place
examples: Oceans occupy about seventy percent of the Earth's surface.
Different occupations require different skills.

definition: something that can be chosen
examples: Solar power is an attractive option for sunny regions.
Students may take an optional course in statistics.

definition: the amount of something produced
examples: Agricultural output increased after irrigation was introduced.
The output of a solar panel depends on the amount of sunlight.

definition: considering everything; in general
examples: The overall rate of crime fell during the decade.
Overall, the experiment was a success.

definition: side by side and the same distance apart; similar
examples: Lines of latitude are parallel to the equator.
There are interesting parallels between the two ancient cultures.

definition: a limit or factor that defines how something is done
examples: Temperature is a key parameter in the experiment.
The researchers set clear parameters for the study.

definition: a stage in a process of change
examples: The Moon passes through several phases each month.
The first phase of the project involved collecting samples.

definition: to say what will happen in the future
examples: Meteorologists predict the weather using computer models.
Earthquakes remain very difficult to predict.

definition: most important; main
examples: Rice is the principal food crop in much of Asia.
The principal cause of the decline was habitat loss.

definition: happening or existing before something else
examples: Prior to the invention of the clock, people used sundials.
Participants had no prior knowledge of the task.

definition: relating to a job that needs special training
examples: Doctors and lawyers belong to professional organizations.
Teaching became a recognized profession in the nineteenth century.

definition: a planned piece of work with a particular aim
examples: The Human Genome Project mapped human genes.
Scientists project that sea levels will continue to rise.

definition: to help something grow, develop, or become popular
examples: Exercise promotes good health.
The government ran campaigns for the promotion of reading.

definition: a government or a system of rules
examples: The regime controlled the press and limited free speech.
Patients followed a strict exercise regime.

definition: to find a solution to a problem or disagreement
examples: The two countries resolved the border dispute through talks.
The resolution of the telescope allows astronomers to see fine detail.

definition: to keep or continue to have something
examples: Clay soils retain water longer than sandy soils.
Retention of new vocabulary improves with regular review.

definition: a number of similar things that come one after another
examples: The scientist conducted a series of experiments.
The Hawaiian Islands formed as a series of volcanoes.

definition: a number that represents a fact or measurement
examples: Government statistics show a rise in employment.
The researchers used statistical methods to analyze the data.

definition: social or legal position; the condition of something
examples: In many societies, land ownership gave people high status.
The study reports on the conservation status of each species.

definition: pressure or worry; force on an object
examples: Long-term stress can affect the immune system.
Engineers test how much stress a bridge can carry.

definition: coming after something else
examples: The drought and the subsequent famine caused great hardship.
The theory was subsequently confirmed by other scientists.

definition: the total of two or more numbers; an amount of money
examples: The sum of the angles in a triangle is 180 degrees.
The government spent large sums on new roads.

definition: a short statement of the main points
examples: The article begins with a brief summary of the findings.
Students learned to summarize long reading passages.

definition: to begin or take responsibility for a task
examples: Several countries undertook voyages of exploration in the fifteenth century.
The survey was a large undertaking that took two years.

definition: a school or society for special study or knowledge
examples: Plato founded the Academy in Athens.
She has an academic background in economics.

definition: to change something slightly to make it fit or work better
examples: The pupil of the eye adjusts to changes in light.
Farmers made adjustments to their planting schedules.

definition: to change something
examples: Rivers can alter the shape of the land over time.
Genetic alterations can affect how a plant grows.

definition: to change a law or document to improve it
examples: The U.S. Constitution has been amended twenty-seven times.
The First Amendment protects freedom of speech.

definition: knowing that something exists or is happening
examples: Many people are not aware of how much water they use.
Public awareness of pollution grew in the twentieth century.

definition: the amount something can contain or produce; ability
examples: The stadium has a capacity of fifty thousand people.
Young children have a remarkable capacity to learn languages.

definition: something difficult that tests ability
examples: Feeding a growing population is a major challenge.
The new data challenged the accepted theory.

definition: a part of a sentence or legal document
examples: An adjective clause describes a noun.
The contract included a clause about payment dates.

definition: a substance made of two or more elements
examples: Water is a compound of hydrogen and oxygen.
Salt is a chemical compound of sodium and chlorine.

definition: a serious disagreement or fight
examples: Conflict over water resources is common in dry regions.
The two reports gave conflicting accounts of the event.

definition: to ask for advice or information
examples: Historians consult original documents whenever possible.
Patients should consult a doctor before taking new medicine.

definition: communication or physical touching
examples: European contact brought new diseases to the Americas.
The disease spreads through direct contact with infected animals.

definition: to become smaller or weaker
examples: Bird populations have declined in many farming regions.
The decline of the Roman Empire took several centuries.

definition: separate and different from others
examples: The data were divided into discrete categories.
Light energy is carried in discrete units called photons.

definition: an early version of a piece of writing
examples: Thomas Jefferson wrote the first draft of the Declaration of Independence.
Writers usually revise several drafts.

definition: to make it possible for someone to do something
examples: The printing press enabled ideas to spread quickly.
Long legs enable the giraffe to run fast.

definition: power from sources such as fuel or sunlight; the ability to do work
examples: Plants convert light energy into chemical energy.
Wind and solar power are renewable sources of energy.

definition: to make sure a law or rule is obeyed
examples: Police enforce traffic laws.
Enforcement of fishing limits helps protect fish populations.

definition: something that exists as a separate unit
examples: The European Union is a political and economic entity.
In law, a company is treated as a separate entity.

definition: equal in value, amount, or meaning
examples: One kilometer is equivalent to 1,000 meters.
Some English words have no exact equivalent in Thai.

definition: to develop gradually over time
examples: Whales evolved from land mammals.
The theory of evolution explains the diversity of life.

definition: to become larger
examples: Most metals expand when they are heated.
The expansion of railroads changed the American economy.

definition: to leave something uncovered or unprotected
examples: Erosion has exposed ancient rock layers in the canyon.
Long exposure to loud noise can damage hearing.

definition: on or from the outside
examples: Insects have an external skeleton.
The economy was affected by external factors such as oil prices.

definition: to make an action or process easier
examples: Enzymes facilitate chemical reactions in the body.
Good roads facilitate trade between regions.

definition: basic and very important
examples: Gravity is one of the fundamental forces of nature.
The two theories are fundamentally different.

definition: to produce or create something
examples: Wind turbines generate electricity.
Dams are used for the generation of hydroelectric power.

definition: all the people born at about the same time; a stage of development
examples: Stories were passed down from one generation to the next.
Each new generation of computers is faster than the last.

definition: a picture or mental idea of something
examples: Satellite images show the loss of forest cover.
The telescope produced clear images of distant galaxies.

definition: open to new ideas; supporting individual freedom
examples: Liberal ideas influenced the French Revolution.
Many colleges offer a liberal arts education.

definition: an official document that gives permission to do something
examples: Doctors need a license to practice medicine.
In many countries, a license is required to fish in public waters.

definition: a way of reasoning carefully
examples: Mathematics depends on strict logic.
The argument was logical and easy to follow.

definition: the edge of something; a small amount of difference
examples: The law passed by a narrow margin.
Many plants grow along the margins of the lake.

definition: relating to the treatment of illness and injury
examples: Medical research has greatly increased life expectancy.
X-rays became an important medical tool in the twentieth century.

definition: relating to the mind
examples: Regular exercise can improve mental health.
The tasks measured mental skills such as memory.

definition: to change something slightly
examples: Scientists have modified crops to resist insects.
The design was modified after early tests.

definition: to watch or check something over a period of time
examples: Satellites monitor changes in sea ice.
Nurses monitor patients' heart rates.

definition: a system of connected lines, people, or things
examples: The Romans built a vast network of roads.
Neurons form complex networks in the brain.

definition: an idea or belief
examples: The notion that the Earth is flat was rejected by ancient Greek scholars.
Modern physics challenged the notion of absolute time.

definition: an aim or goal; (adj.) not influenced by personal feelings
examples: The main objective of the mission was to study the planet's atmosphere.
Scientists try to remain objective when they analyze data.

definition: to find or set a position or direction
examples: Migrating birds may use the Earth's magnetic field to orient themselves.
Many ancient temples have a specific orientation toward the rising sun.

definition: a way of thinking about something; a method of showing depth in art
examples: Renaissance painters used perspective to create a sense of depth.
The book examines the war from the perspective of ordinary soldiers.

definition: exact and accurate
examples: Atomic clocks keep extremely precise time.
The precise cause of the disease is unknown.

definition: main or most important; of the best quality
examples: Habitat loss is a prime cause of species decline.
A prime number can be divided only by 1 and itself.

definition: the scientific study of the mind and behavior
examples: Psychology became a separate science in the late nineteenth century.
Psychologists study how memory works.

definition: to follow or try to achieve something
examples: Many students pursue graduate degrees abroad.
Cheetahs pursue their prey at high speed.

definition: the relationship between two amounts
examples: The ratio of students to teachers was twenty to one.
The ratio of oxygen to nitrogen in air is about one to four.

definition: to refuse to accept something
examples: Many scientists at first rejected the idea of continental drift.
The body may reject a transplanted organ.

definition: money that a government or business receives
examples: Taxes are the main source of government revenue.
Tourism brings significant revenue to coastal towns.

definition: not likely to change or move
examples: The climate remained relatively stable for thousands of years.
Political stability encourages economic growth.

definition: a particular way of doing, making, or designing something
examples: Gothic cathedrals share a distinctive architectural style.
Hemingway wrote in a simple, direct style.

definition: to use one thing in place of another
examples: Some cooks substitute honey for sugar.
Plastic became a cheap substitute for many natural materials.

definition: to keep something going over time
examples: The soil could not sustain crops without regular rain.
Sustainable fishing protects fish populations for the future.

definition: a sign or object that represents something else
examples: The chemical symbol for gold is Au.
The olive branch is a symbol of peace.

definition: something that is aimed at; a goal
examples: The government set a target for cutting emissions.
The vaccine targets a specific virus.

definition: the movement of people or goods from one place to another
examples: Public transit reduces traffic in large cities.
Some goods are damaged in transit.

definition: a general direction of change
examples: There is a global trend toward urban living.
Economists study long-term trends in prices.

definition: one form of something that differs slightly from others
examples: The first version of the map contained several errors.
There are several versions of the ancient story.

definition: health, happiness, and safety; government help for people in need
examples: Laws protect the welfare of animals used in research.
Many countries expanded welfare programs after World War II.

definition: used to compare two facts that are different
examples: Frogs have smooth skin, whereas toads often have dry, bumpy skin.
Some regions receive heavy rain, whereas others receive almost none.
